requested_operation: match_reuse_or_extend_then_readback; create only verified unmatched residual scope
matching_action: Designated writer compares current scope and retained acceptance, reuses matching issue or adds only genuine residual scope, preserves all original estimates/actuals, and returns native key/readback bound to this specification.

payload.title: Review exact release and rehearse rollback
payload.goal: Make launch a reviewable candidate with a tested recovery procedure.
payload.owner_role: Suggested Lipi executor, admitted by Lipi coordinator
implementation_steps: Capture current theme/catalog/channel/policy/discount snapshot without secrets and hash the exact candidate, cost inputs, sample acceptance and checkout evidence.
Rehearse private restore from the snapshot; distinguish technical rollback capability from permission to change public or irreversible orders.
Obtain attributable independent technical/content review and concrete owner launch decision covering exact catalog/shared surfaces. Limit repairs to2 and invalidate approval if payload drifts.
tests: Restore reproduces snapshot hashes and preserves order/payment receipts.
Unreviewed file or changed price/mapping invalidates candidate admission.

review.identity_requirement: Independent reviewer other than implementing author; record actual reviewer identity, model/version and host. Cultural reviewer identity is additionally required for Guru claims; no invented reviewer.
review.exact_source: Bind source commit, task/spec SHA256, artifact hashes, policy revision and receiving-system receipts; any material change invalidates affected approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review attempts per admitted task, or a stricter existing limit. Unresolved failure becomes needs_input/blocked with evidence; never an unbounded loop.

acceptance: Exact-source independent review and private recovery must pass; failed/withheld review leaves release acceptance incomplete.
Owner can approve one complete current candidate without unspecified future changes.
payload.rollback: Keep existing live state; restore private candidate only; no forced refund or deletion.
payload.next_eligible_action: LIPI-14 applies only the approved cutover.

estimate.assumptions: New incremental planning range, not original Jira estimate or worklog. Reuse accepted assets; elapsed shipping, review waiting, observation windows and provider verification are excluded.
estimate.dependency_risk: Independent reviewer and exact owner launch decision

jira.matching_action: Designated writer compares current scope and retained acceptance, reuses matching issue or adds only genuine residual scope, preserves all original estimates/actuals, and returns native key/readback bound to this specification.

effect_gate_applicability.condition: Public product/theme/catalog/shared-surface cutover only: exact independent review, owner launch grant, preimage and reversible rollback.

conditional_effect_gates.condition: Public product/theme/catalog/shared-surface cutover only: exact independent review, owner launch grant, preimage and reversible rollback.

payload.effect_gate_semantics: effect_gates is a capability-gate catalogue. Evaluate each conditional_effect_gates entry only for its named actual action class; never require all unrelated gates as a conjunction.
payload.completion_rule: A blocked/missing-input/failure record may finish a preparation subunit only. This task is not capability/release complete until its positive checks and relevant real effect acceptance pass. Disabled unrelated effect classes do not block a qualified allowed class; claimed scope is explicit.
